Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated Khufu (Meritites I’s husband) with Khafre and incorrectly stated that Khufu was buried in the Pyramid of Khafre. This misinterpretation contradicts the cited Britannica snippet indicating Khufu’s sarcophagus in the King’s Chamber of the Great Pyramid of Giza (Khufu’s pyramid).
